output.summary: KEP-4656 proposes that kubeadm stop setting the CRI socket annotation (kubeadm.alpha.kubernetes.io/cri-socket) on Node objects and stop writing --container-runtime-endpoint to kubeadm-flags.env. Instead, kubeadm writes a per-node /var/lib/kubelet/instance-config.yaml containing ContainerRuntimeEndpoint, which is merged into the kubelet config during init/join/upgrade. The KEP is at status implementable, stage alpha.
output.rationale: The CRI socket annotation on the Node object persists even when the kubelet or the container runtime changes, so it can go stale. Moving the endpoint into a per-node instance config lets kubeadm set ContainerRuntimeEndpoint in the kubelet config directly, which removes the need to store it on each Node. The readme frames this as a way to use the migrated container runtime endpoint flag in instance configuration.

alternatives.why_not: The readme notes that kubelet has deprecated the --container-runtime-endpoint args, so continuing to use the flags file is not viable long term.

alternatives.option: Avoid a feature gate and ship compatibility across multiple versions
alternatives.why_not: The readme says it prefers adding a feature gate to improve user awareness, so this option was not chosen.

evidence.quote: Instead of relying on the annotation, this KEP proses creating an instance config per node and overriding the `ContainerRuntimeEndpoint` in the kubelet config when calling kubeadm commands
This annotation is persistent on the Node object, even if the kubelet is updated or the CRI is changed.
This file will be merged with `/var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml` in the process of kubeadm init/join by using the `kubeletconfiguration` patch target.
Do nothing, continue to use the`/var/lib/kubelet/kubeadm-flags.env` file, but kubelet has deprecated the `--container-runtime-endpoint` args.
